newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sales by Brazil Philips unit grow 16.9 pct - report.
newsitem.headline: Sales by Brazil Philips unit grow 16.9 pct - report.

text.p: Sales by Philips do Brasil, the Brazilian unit of Philips Electronics NV, reached $1.78 billion in 1996, a rise of 16.9 percent on 1995, according to local news agency Invest News.
The company hopes 1997 revenue will grow by a further 10 percent to $1.9 billion, Invest News added.
The sound and vision divison accounted for 43 percent of last year's sales, while components contributed a further 31.3 percent.
In December last year, a company spokesman said sales in 1996 were expected to reach $1.8 billion.
Philips do Brasil officials were unavailable to comment on the latest report.
Brazil accounts for 70 percent of all Philips' sales in South America.
